assets.usage: Website preview generated from diagram 1 in solution.tex; editable source remains inline in solution.tex.

diagram_previews.alt: Obtuse triangle ABC with angles 30 degrees at A, 140 degrees at B and 10 degrees at C, inside its grey circumcircle with centre O; red dashed radii OA, OB, OC with the 20 degree angle AOB marked, and the blue triangle BCD below BC with angle 80 degrees at C and 20 degrees at B.

difficulty_rationale: Finding a trigonometry-free argument needs the circumcircle of ABC, which makes BC equal to the circumradius, and a congruent comparison triangle.
